##Prework for excercise
```{r}
## Prework for Exercise

# Load required package
library(tseries)

# Load dataset
load("GSPC.RData")

# Inspect column names
colnames(GSPC)

# Extract adjusted closing prices
P <- as.numeric(GSPC[, "GSPC.Adjusted"])

# Remove missing values
P <- na.omit(P)

# Calculate log-returns
r <- 100 * diff(log(P))

# Remove missing values
r <- na.omit(r)

# Display first observations
head(P)
head(r)

# Summary statistics
summary(P)
summary(r)

#extra check!
length(P)
length(r)
```

##Question 1.1: Stationarity Tests

```{r}
# ADF test for adjusted closing prices
adf_price <- adf.test(P)

# ADF test for log-returns
adf_return <- adf.test(r)

# Display results
adf_price
adf_return
```
###Why not run a kpss test too?
```{r}
## KPSS Stationarity Tests

# KPSS test for adjusted closing prices
kpss_price <- kpss.test(P)

# KPSS test for log-returns
kpss_return <- kpss.test(r)

# Display results
kpss_price
kpss_return
```


## Question 1.2
```{r}
# Packages
library(moments)
library(tseries)

# Plot log-returns
plot(r,
     type = "l",
     col = "blue",
     main = "S&P 500 Log-Returns",
     ylab = "Return (%)",
     xlab = "Time")

abline(h = 0, col = "red")

# Skewness and kurtosis
skew_r <- skewness(as.numeric(r))
kurt_r <- kurtosis(as.numeric(r))

cat("Skewness =", skew_r, "\n")
cat("Kurtosis =", kurt_r, "\n")

Box.test(as.numeric(r), lag = 5, type = "Ljung-Box")
Box.test(as.numeric(r), lag = 10, type = "Ljung-Box")
Box.test(as.numeric(r), lag = 20, type = "Ljung-Box")
Box.test(as.numeric(r), lag = 40, type = "Ljung-Box")

# ACF plot
acf(as.numeric(r),
    main = "ACF of Log-Returns")
```

##1.3
```{r}
# Calculate squared log-returns (skip this if you already did it)
r_squared <- r^2

# Plot squared log-returns
plot(r_squared,
     type = "l",
     main = "Squared S&P 500 Log-Returns",
     xlab = "Time",
     ylab = "Squared Log-Returns")

# Ljung-Box test on squared log-returns
Box.test(as.numeric(r_squared),
         lag = 20,
         type = "Ljung-Box")

acf(r_squared,
    main = "ACF of Squared S&P 500 Log-Returns",
    lag.max = 40)
```

```{r}
library(FinTS)

ArchTest(as.numeric(r), lags = 20)
```

##1.6
```{r}
library(rugarch)
library(FinTS)
library(tseries)

# Specification: constant mean, GARCH(1,1), normal innovations
spec <- ugarchspec(
  variance.model = list(model = "sGARCH", garchOrder = c(1, 1)),
  mean.model     = list(armaOrder = c(0, 0), include.mean = TRUE),
  distribution.model = "norm"
)

# Estimate
fit <- ugarchfit(spec = spec, data = as.numeric(r))
fit   # prints coefficients, robust s.e., LB tests, ARCH-LM, information criteria

# Parameter estimates
coef(fit)      # mu (= phi0), omega (= alpha0), alpha1, beta1

# Persistence and unconditional variance
a1 <- coef(fit)["alpha1"]; b1 <- coef(fit)["beta1"]; a0 <- coef(fit)["omega"]
persistence <- a1 + b1
uncond_var  <- a0 / (1 - persistence)
persistence
uncond_var
sqrt(uncond_var)

# Diagnostics on standardized residuals
z <- as.numeric(residuals(fit, standardize = TRUE))

# 1) Autocorrelation in standardized residuals (mean equation)
Box.test(z,   lag = 20, type = "Ljung-Box")

# 2) Remaining ARCH in squared standardized residuals (variance equation)
Box.test(z^2, lag = 20, type = "Ljung-Box")
ArchTest(z, lags = 20)

# 3) Normality of standardized residuals
jarque.bera.test(z)
library(moments)
skewness(z); kurtosis(z)

# Plots
acf(z,   main = "ACF of standardized residuals")
acf(z^2, main = "ACF of squared standardized residuals")
qqnorm(z); qqline(z, col = "red")
plot(sigma(fit), type = "l", main = "Estimated conditional volatility",
     ylab = "sigma_t", xlab = "Time")
```
